events.title: A divided election makes Alexander III pope
events.description: After the death of Adrian IV, a majority of the cardinals elected Cardinal Rolando of Siena as Pope Alexander III, but a minority chose Ottaviano de Monticelli as Victor IV, beginning a schism that lasted until 1178.
events.html: After the death of Adrian IV, a majority of the cardinals elected Cardinal Rolando of Siena as Pope Alexander III, but a minority chose Ottaviano de Monticelli as Victor IV, beginning a schism that lasted until 1178.

events.title: Richard the Lionheart defeats Saladin at Arsuf
events.description: Marching down the coast, Richard's army withstood harassing attacks before a crusader charge broke Saladin's forces at Arsuf. The victory let the crusaders take Jaffa.
events.html: Marching down the coast, Richard's army withstood harassing attacks before a crusader charge broke Saladin's forces at Arsuf. The victory let the crusaders take Jaffa.

events.title: Frederick II lands at Acre on the Sixth Crusade
events.description: Emperor Frederick II arrived at Acre and was warmly received by the Templars, Hospitallers and clergy, but, being excommunicated by Pope Gregory IX, was denied the kiss of peace. Without a major battle, he negotiated Jerusalem's return to Christian rule in 1229.

events.title: French troops seize Pope Boniface VIII at Anagni
events.description: After Pope Boniface VIII excommunicated Philip IV of France, the king's troops, led by his councillor Guillaume de Nogaret, attacked the pope's residence at Anagni and captured him. Boniface was held for three days and died a month later.
events.html: After Pope Boniface VIII excommunicated Philip IV of France, the king's troops, led by his councillor Guillaume de Nogaret, attacked the pope's residence at Anagni and captured him. Boniface was held for three days and died a month later.

events.title: The future Elizabeth I is born at Greenwich
events.description: Anne Boleyn gave birth to a daughter, Elizabeth, a disappointment to Henry VIII, who wanted a son. As queen for 44 years she defeated the Armada and presided over a golden age of English culture.

events.title: The submarine Turtle makes the first submarine attack
events.description: Sergeant Ezra Lee steered David Bushnell's one-man submarine Turtle towards HMS Eagle in New York Harbor. He failed to attach the charge to the hull, but it was the first submarine attack in war.

events.title: Napoleon and Kutuzov fight the Battle of Borodino
events.description: Some 70,000 men fell at Borodino, the bloodiest single day of the Napoleonic Wars. The Russians withdrew, and a week later Napoleon entered an abandoned Moscow that was soon ablaze.

events.title: The Blitz begins with a massive raid on London
events.description: The Luftwaffe switched to bombing London, starting 57 consecutive nights of raids. The Blitz killed some 43,000 civilians by May 1941 but failed to break British morale.
